ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Unable to account for it or sort it out.
EvidenceBody: Frozen-corpus concordance: 107 exact hits in 66 storage files representing 66 independent works. An unnamed questioner says he cannot account for a distinction between expounding teachings and responding to the occasion; Yuan’an Feng tells another questioner, ‘Look at you, unable to account for it’; and Yuan’an, Linye Tongqi, and Linye Tongqi’s later lamp-record version use it of their own inability to settle a fan-name test, a north-or-south salutation, or which recorded saying is deep or shallow. Zhaozhou Congshen’s ‘the highest way is not difficult’ exchange supplies a famous duration formula: he says someone once asked him and he was unable to account for it for five years. Yuan’an’s later letter turns the verb back on the reader: if unable to account for it, one must carefully account for it.
